There's an ongoing discussion in the r-package-devel mailing list with the subject "Questions and advice about restoring user's par()" that contains some good discussion clarifying <https://contributor.r-project.org/cran-cookbook/code_issues.html#change-of-options-graphical-parameters-and-working-directory|https://contributor.r-project.org/cran-cookbook/code_issues.html#change-of-options-graphical-parameters-and-working-directory> . I'd be happy to summarize the suggestions in an edit to that topic, or in a new topic if desired.
Should I post the edits here, or submit a PR, or does someone else want to do this?
